title: Bihar BCECE 2026 First Round Allotment Result
organization: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board
vacancyDetails: 1st round seat allotment for BCECE admission 2026 courses
qualification: As per BCECE eligibility for applied course
documentsRequired: Allotment letter, rank card, certificates, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
2. Login to counselling portal
3. Download 1st round allotment result
4. Report to allotted college as scheduled
shortDescription: BCECE Admission 2026 1st Round Allotment Result out. Check seat at bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
content:
BCECE Board has published the 1st Round Allotment Result for BCECE Admission 2026.

Candidates must download the allotment letter and complete admission formalities at the allotted institute within the given timeline.
